messages:
nina: Quick follow-up from today's infra all-hands Q&A 1 — drop any clarifying ops questions here re: GPUs, autoscale, and customer comms. We'll triage. :mega:

raj: TL;DR on hardware: primary procurement is H100s for US/EMEA; APAC will get mixed A100/H100 due to regional supply. H100 racks arrive mid-June in US, late-June for EMEA, and APAC staggered from late-June to early-July depending on customs.

emma: For Dedicated customers, will we do live model VM/mig during node maintenance or require draining? Our customers run latency-sensitive features.

raj: We'll do rolling drains only. No live VM-level migration. Plan: drain pods, spin up warm pool in parallel, route traffic when warm. That avoids tail-latency hits. We'll surface the scheduled windows in Console with a "maintenance" tag.

li: Can you share the warm-pool / pre-warm config snippet you mentioned? Cold-starts are a big pain for our latency SLOs.

emma: Example pre-warm config we prototype (numbers are examples):

```yaml
warm_pool:
  enabled: true
  min_warm_instances: 3
  model_profiles:
    - name: chat-medium
      prewarm_count: 2
      prewarm_memory_mb: 48000
  eviction_policy: least_recent
  prewarm_grace_sec: 45
```

raj: Note: warm pools will be tunable per-deployment and gated by quota. We expect to default warm pools ON for Dedicated latency-critical routes. Hosted customers can opt-in via route config.

paul: How will this impact page/public status and billing? Do we bill for warm instances? Customers want clarity.

harini: Billing: warm instances are billed if they're reserved capacity (Dedicated). For hosted, pre-warmed instances charged while active. Were working on a Console estimator so customers can see cost impact before enabling. Public status: we will post planned maintenance windows and an entry for the rollout phases.

raj: On autoscale: were introducing two controls: "aggressive" (fast spin-up, higher burst cost) and "cost-optimized" (slower ramp, larger batching). Default is cost-optimized for hosted; Dedicated can choose. We'll publish threshold numbers next week with benchmarks.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: infra/maintenance-schedule.yml promoted to prod at 2026-04-14T20:05Z :white_check_mark:

nina: Can we get a short checklist for product and support to prepare customer comms and runbooks? Who owns the doc?

raj: Assigning owners: @harini to draft customer-facing FAQ & status entries, @emma to draft runbook/playbook for Dedicated ops. I'll add a migration checklist for teams that need strict region pinning. We'll share a single doc in #docs by EOD Friday.

li: One last ask   will cross-region failover be visible in the Console audit logs? Need that for SRE postmortems.

raj: Yes  routing events and cross-region failovers will be logged with reason codes (capacity/maintenance/degraded). We'll include sampling of token-level latency impact for customers requesting it.

nina: Perfect. If no more Qs, we'll wait for the shared doc and tag this thread closed. Thanks all :clap:
